Two human arms/hands are visible gripping the rail; one on the left wearing a blue sleeve, and one on the right also in blue denim-like fabric. The handrail is dark and sleek, mounted on light-colored, blocky steps. In the background, there is a potted green plant and a blurred architectural setting with windows.
